"""Bulk link creation: shorten up to 100 URLs in one request.

Each item is validated and created independently, so one bad URL does not fail the batch.
Every item counts against the caller's rate limit; items over the limit are reported as
failed rather than silently dropped.
"""

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

from service.api.routes import get_link_service, to_response
from service.api.schemas import CreateUrlRequest, ErrorResponse, UrlResponse
from service.core.links import AliasTakenError, CodeSpaceExhaustedError, LinkService
from service.core.validation import ValidationError

MAX_BATCH = 100

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1", tags=["urls"])


class BulkCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    items: list[CreateUrlRequest] = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=MAX_BATCH)


class BulkItemResult(BaseModel):
    index: int
    ok: bool
    link: UrlResponse | None = None
    error: str | None = None


class BulkCreateResponse(BaseModel):
    created: int
    failed: int
    results: list[BulkItemResult]


@router.post(
    "/urls/bulk",
    response_model=BulkCreateResponse,
    responses={422: {"model": ErrorResponse, "description": "Invalid batch"}},
)
def bulk_create(
    body: BulkCreateRequest,
    request: Request,
    service: LinkService = Depends(get_link_service),
) -> BulkCreateResponse:
    limiter = request.app.state.rate_limiter
    client = request.client.host if request.client else "unknown"
    base_url = request.app.state.settings.base_url

    results: list[BulkItemResult] = []
    for index, item in enumerate(body.items):
        if not limiter.allow(client):
            results.append(BulkItemResult(index=index, ok=False, error="rate limit exceeded"))
            continue
        try:
            created = service.create(
                item.url, custom_alias=item.custom_alias, expires_at=item.expires_at
            )
        except (ValidationError, AliasTakenError, CodeSpaceExhaustedError) as exc:
            results.append(BulkItemResult(index=index, ok=False, error=str(exc)))
        else:
            results.append(
                BulkItemResult(index=index, ok=True, link=to_response(created.url, base_url))
            )

    ok = sum(r.ok for r in results)
    return BulkCreateResponse(created=ok, failed=len(results) - ok, results=results)
